color.$description: Semantic color roles for johnthedesigner.com. Architecture: Named palette (Model 3) — two hue families (blue + slate), explicit brand control, semantic roles mapped from primitives. Light mode values. Dark mode overrides in color.dark.json.

primitive.$description: Raw palette values. Consumed only by semantic layer — never referenced directly by components.

50.$description: Blue tint — hover surfaces on blue-50 bg

100.$description: Blue tint — focus ring glow, tinted containers

200.$description: Blue mid-light — dark mode link underlines, decorative borders

300.$description: Blue mid — dark mode links; 7.31:1 on slate-900 (AAA)

400.$description: Blue mid-vivid — dark mode accents, icons

500.$description: PRIMARY — all solid fills, section backgrounds, badges, borders, focus rings, icon accents. 3.67:1 on white — non-text UI only.

600.$description: PRIMARY TEXT — interactive text (links, button labels). 4.81:1 on white — AA ✓

700.$description: Blue dark — available for pressed states, deep emphasis

50.$description: Slate tint — subtle backgrounds, tag fills, code block bg

100.$description: Slate light — default dividers/borders, dark mode body text (13.18:1 on slate-900)

300.$description: Slate mid — dark mode muted text, decorative elements

400.$description: Slate mid-dark — placeholder text, inactive icons

500.$description: Slate muted — captions, metadata. 8.06:1 on white — AA ✓

600.$description: BODY TEXT — primary prose color. 11.26:1 on white — AA ✓

800.$description: Slate dark — dark mode card surface

900.$description: HEADINGS + DARK SURFACE — display and heading text; dark mode page bg. 18.07:1 on white — AA ✓

error.$description: Error fill. Slate-900 text only: 9.19:1 — AA ✓. Never as text on white.

success.$description: Success fill. Slate-900 text only: 11.84:1 — AA ✓. Never as text on white.

warning.$description: Warning fill. Slate-900 text only: 14.25:1 — AA ✓. Never as text on white.

error-surface.$description: Decorative tint only. No text on this color.

success-surface.$description: Decorative tint only. No text on this color.

warning-surface.$description: Decorative tint only. No text on this color.

primary.$description: Primary brand color. All solid fills, section backgrounds, badges, decorative borders, focus rings, icon accents. 3.67:1 on white — not suitable for text. Use color.primary-text for interactive text.

primary-text.$description: Primary interactive text color. Links, button labels, any inline blue. 4.81:1 on white — AA ✓

primary-hover.$description: Hover state for primary-filled elements. Blue-600 provides visible darkening.

primary-subtle.$description: Very light blue tint for hover states on ghost elements, badge outlines background.

surface.$description: Default page surface. Pure white — the primary background for all content.

surface-raised.$description: Raised surface — cards, sheets. Same color as surface; differentiated from page by shadow-sm, not by color.

surface-overlay.$description: Overlay surface — modals, dialogs, drawers. Differentiated by shadow-lg.

surface-subtle.$description: Subtle tinted surface — tag fills, code blocks, callout aside backgrounds. Slate-50 (#edf1f5).

on-surface.$description: Primary text on surface — display, headings, UI labels requiring maximum contrast. 18.07:1 on white — AA ✓

on-surface-body.$description: Body text on surface — all prose, descriptions, card copy. 11.26:1 on white — AA ✓

on-surface-muted.$description: Muted text on surface — captions, timestamps, placeholder text, secondary metadata. 8.06:1 on white — AA ✓

on-surface-placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in inputs. 4.73:1 on white — AA ✓ for large text; use sparingly at small sizes.

border.$description: Default border/divider — horizontal rules, section separators, flat card outlines.

border-mid.$description: Stronger border — input resting state, table rows, visible structural lines.

border-focus.$description: Focus ring border color. 3.67:1 on white — passes WCAG 1.4.11 non-text 3:1 threshold ✓. Used at 2px width with glow offset.

border-active.$description: Active/selected border — same as primary. Used for selected tab underlines, active nav indicators.

error.$description: Error fill (#FAA1A1). Slate-900 text only: 9.19:1 — AA ✓. Bright pastel — softer than conventional alert red.

success.$description: Success fill (#A1DFB7). Slate-900 text only: 11.84:1 — AA ✓.

warning.$description: Warning fill (#F8E49A). Slate-900 text only: 14.25:1 — AA ✓.

error-surface.$description: Decorative error tint (#fff1f1). No text on this color — use as background behind error fill elements only.

success-surface.$description: Decorative success tint (#ecfdf5). No text on this color.

warning-surface.$description: Decorative warning tint (#fffbeb). No text on this color.
